BFS finds the shortest path on an unweig.zh: BFS 能在无权图上找到最短路径，却因盲目探索而浪费精力。Dijkstra 能处理边权，却无视目标所在。A* 引入启发式函数便能径直抵达——前提是该启发式是可采纳的。在网格上绘制墙壁，观察四种搜索算法如何扩展各自的前沿，并看清每一种究竟在何处浪费了工作。
BFS finds the shortest path on an unweig.src:
BFS finds the shortest path on an unweighted graph but
          wastes effort exploring blindly. Dijkstra handles edge
          weights but ignores the goal. A* adds a heuristic and
          goes straight there — when the heuristic is admissible.
          Draw walls on a grid, watch four search algorithms expand
          their frontiers, and see exactly where each one wastes
          work.

One scaffold, four algorithms.zh: 同一套脚手架，四种算法

The four classic single-source shortest-.zh: 四种经典的单源最短路径 / 可达性算法——BFS、DFS、Dijkstra、A*——共用同一套脚手架。维护一个@@T0@@前沿@@T1@@，其中存放已发现但尚未最终确定的节点。取出一个，标记为已确定，将其邻居加入前沿。重复此过程，直至抵达目标（或前沿清空）。
The four classic single-source shortest-.src: The four classic single-source shortest-path / reachability algorithms — BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, A* — share a single scaffold. Maintain a frontier of nodes you've discovered but not yet finalised. Pop one off, mark it finalised, add its neighbours to the frontier. Repeat until you reach the goal (or the frontier empties).

What changes between them? @@T0@@The dat.zh: 它们之间的差异何在？@@T0@@在于支撑前沿的数据结构。@@T1@@
What changes between them? @@T0@@The dat.src: What changes between them? The data structure backing the frontier.

@@T0@@BFS@@T1@@ uses a FIFO queue → pops.zh: @@T0@@BFS@@T1@@使用 FIFO 队列 → 先取出最浅的节点 → 在无权图上找到最短路径。
@@T0@@BFS@@T1@@ uses a FIFO queue → pops.src: BFS uses a FIFO queue → pops the shallowest node first → finds the shortest path on unweighted graphs.

@@T0@@DFS@@T1@@ uses a LIFO stack → pops.zh: @@T0@@DFS@@T1@@使用 LIFO 栈 → 先取出最深的节点 → 找到@@T2@@某条@@T3@@路径而非最短路径，但内存占用少得多。
@@T0@@DFS@@T1@@ uses a LIFO stack → pops.src: DFS uses a LIFO stack → pops the deepest node first → finds some path, not the shortest, but uses much less memory.

@@T0@@Dijkstra@@T1@@ uses a min-priority.zh: @@T0@@Dijkstra@@T1@@使用以当前路径代价为键的最小优先队列 → 取出离起点代价最低的节点 → 在边权非负的带权图上达到最优。
@@T0@@Dijkstra@@T1@@ uses a min-priority.src: Dijkstra uses a min-priority queue keyed on path cost so far → pops the cheapest-from-start node → optimal on weighted graphs with non-negative edges.

@@T0@@A*@@T1@@ uses a min-priority queue.zh: @@T0@@A*@@T1@@使用以 $f(n) = g(n) + h(n)$ 为键的最小优先队列（当前代价加上到目标的启发式估计）→ 取出最有希望的节点 → 只要 $h$ 可采纳即为最优。
@@T0@@A*@@T1@@ uses a min-priority queue.src: A* uses a min-priority queue keyed on $f(n) = g(n) + h(n)$ (cost so far plus heuristic estimate to goal) → pops the most promising node → optimal whenever $h$ is admissible.

Different priority order, different beha.zh: 优先级顺序不同，行为便不同，底层循环却相同。
Different priority order, different beha.src:
Different priority order, different behaviour, same
          underlying loop.

Pick a tool, click cells to paint. Walls.zh: 选择一种工具，点击单元格进行涂绘。墙壁（黑色）不可通行。泥地（棕色）可通行，但代价是普通步长的 5 倍——只有 Dijkstra 与 A* 会在意这一点。可将绿色起点或红色目标拖至任意位置。然后按下 @@T0@@运行@@T1@@。
Pick a tool, click cells to paint. Walls.src: Pick a tool, click cells to paint. Walls (black) block movement. Mud (brown) is passable but costs 5× a normal step — only Dijkstra and A* will care. Drag the green start or red goal anywhere. Then press run.

draw walls, then press run..zh: 请绘制墙壁，然后按下运行。

Clear walls, run BFS and A* on the same.zh: 清除墙壁，在同一空网格上运行 BFS 与 A*。BFS 会探索一个近似方形、半径等于到目标距离的区域。A* 则绘出一个指向目标的椭圆。最短路径相同，工作量却天差地别。
Clear walls, run BFS and A* on the same.src:
Clear walls, run BFS and A* on the same empty grid.
            BFS explores a square-ish region of radius equal to the
            distance to goal. A* draws an oval pointed at the goal.
            Same shortest path, dramatically different work.

Paint a long horizontal mud strip betwee.zh: 在起点与目标之间绘制一条长长的水平泥地带。运行 BFS——它对每一步一视同仁，因此径直穿过。运行 Dijkstra——它会绕行。
Paint a long horizontal mud strip betwee.src:
Paint a long horizontal mud strip between start and
            goal. Run BFS — it counts every step the same, so it
            cuts straight through. Run Dijkstra — it routes around.

Draw a C-shaped wall around the goal so.zh: 在目标周围绘制一道 C 形墙壁，使算法不得不回溯。运行贪心最佳优先；它会一头扎向目标，直到被挡住才意识到错误。A* 能够恢复；贪心则不能。
Draw a C-shaped wall around the goal so.src:
Draw a C-shaped wall around the goal so the algorithm
            has to back-track. Run greedy best-first; it dives at
            the goal and only realises its mistake when blocked.
            A* recovers; greedy doesn't.

Run DFS in an empty grid. It produces a.zh: 在空网格中运行 DFS。它会产生一条极其漫长的路径，随后走到尽头便放弃。DFS 不适用于最短路径问题，而这一演示使其显而易见。
Run DFS in an empty grid. It produces a.src:
Run DFS in an empty grid. It produces a wildly long
            path, then runs to the end and gives up. DFS is wrong
            for shortest-path problems and the demo makes it
            visible.

BFS — the unweighted shortest-path tool.zh: BFS——无权图的最短路径工具

Pop from a FIFO queue. Each pop either i.zh: 从 FIFO 队列中取出。每次取出要么是目标（返回），要么将其未访问的邻居入队。由于队列是 FIFO 的，每个节点都在其@@T0@@最浅@@T1@@的发现深度被取出——即距起点的边数。
Pop from a FIFO queue. Each pop either i.src: Pop from a FIFO queue. Each pop either is the goal (return) or pushes its unvisited neighbours. Because the queue is FIFO, every node is popped at its shallowest discovery depth — the number of edges from the start.

BFS is @@T0@@optimal@@T1@@ on unweighted.zh: BFS 在无权图（或边权一致的图）上是@@T0@@最优@@T1@@的，运行时间为 $O(V + E)$。一旦各边权重不同，它就@@T2@@不再@@T3@@最优：BFS 将泥地单元格与空地单元格同等对待。这正是 Dijkstra 所解决的问题。
BFS is @@T0@@optimal@@T1@@ on unweighted.src: BFS is optimal on unweighted graphs (or graphs with uniform edge weights) and runs in $O(V + E)$ time. It is not optimal once edges have different weights: BFS treats a mud cell the same as an empty one. That's the problem Dijkstra fixes.

DFS — depth-first, useful for the wrong.zh: DFS——深度优先，因别的理由而有用
DFS — depth-first, useful for the wrong.src: DFS — depth-first, useful for the wrong reasons

Pop from a LIFO stack instead of a queue.zh: 从 LIFO 栈而非队列中取出。你会尽可能深入，直至需要回溯。DFS 对于最短路径是错误的算法——但下列场景中它却是正确的选择：
Pop from a LIFO stack instead of a queue.src:
Pop from a LIFO stack instead of a queue. You dive as
          deep as possible before backtracking. DFS is the wrong
          algorithm for shortest paths — but it's the right one for:

@@T0@@Topological sort.@@T1@@ Post-order.zh: @@T0@@拓扑排序。@@T1@@对 DAG 做后序 DFS 可得到逆拓扑序。
@@T0@@Topological sort.@@T1@@ Post-order.src: Topological sort. Post-order DFS on a DAG gives you a reverse topological ordering.

@@T0@@Cycle detection.@@T1@@ A back-edge.zh: @@T0@@环检测。@@T1@@DFS 期间出现回边即意味着存在环。
@@T0@@Cycle detection.@@T1@@ A back-edge.src: Cycle detection. A back-edge during DFS = cycle.

@@T0@@Connected components.@@T1@@ Each t.zh: @@T0@@连通分量。@@T1@@每次顶层 DFS 调用勾勒出一个分量。
@@T0@@Connected components.@@T1@@ Each t.src: Connected components. Each top-level DFS call paints one component.

@@T0@@Memory.@@T1@@ DFS uses $O(\\text{d.zh: @@T0@@内存。@@T1@@DFS 使用 $O(\text{depth})$ 内存；BFS 使用 $O(\text{frontier width})$。在宽而浅的图上，DFS 占优。
@@T0@@Memory.@@T1@@ DFS uses $O(\\text{d.src: Memory. DFS uses $O(\text{depth})$ memory; BFS uses $O(\text{frontier width})$. On wide, shallow graphs, DFS dominates.

@@T0@@Articulation points / bridges.@@T1.zh: @@T0@@割点 / 桥。@@T1@@Tarjan 算法通过单次 DFS 遍历同时提取二者。
@@T0@@Articulation points / bridges.@@T1.src: Articulation points / bridges. Tarjan's algorithm extracts both from a single DFS pass.

The grid demo above does shortest path,.zh: 上方的网格演示做的是最短路径，这对 DFS 而言是错误的差事——不妨一试，观察它找到的那条荒谬路径。
The grid demo above does shortest path,.src:
The grid demo above does shortest path, which is the wrong
          job for DFS — try it and observe the absurd path it
          finds.

Dijkstra — BFS with a priority queue.src: Dijkstra — BFS with a priority queue

Replace BFS's FIFO queue with a @@T0@@mi.zh: 将 BFS 的 FIFO 队列替换为以当前已知的最优起点代价为键的@@T0@@最小优先队列@@T1@@。取出代价最小的节点。第一次取出某节点时，你就得到了它的最终最短路径代价。通过@@T2@@松弛@@T3@@更新邻居：
Replace BFS's FIFO queue with a @@T0@@mi.src: Replace BFS's FIFO queue with a min-priority queue keyed on the current best-known cost from start. Pop the node with the smallest cost. The first time you pop a node, you have its final shortest-path cost. Update neighbours by relaxation:

With a binary heap (see the @@T0@@trees\.zh: 使用二叉堆时（参见@@T0@@树@@T1@@一文），Dijkstra 运行时间为 $O((V + E) \log V)$。使用斐波那契堆时为 $O(V \log V + E)$，因为 @@T2@@decrease-key@@T3@@ 操作摊还后变为 $O(1)$。
With a binary heap (see the @@T0@@trees\.src: With a binary heap (see the trees article) Dijkstra runs in $O((V + E) \log V)$. With a Fibonacci heap, $O(V \log V + E)$, because the decrease-key operation becomes $O(1)$ amortised.

@@T0@@Non-negative edges only.@@T1@@\n.zh: @@T0@@仅限非负边。@@T1@@其正确性证明依赖于每条边都具有非负权重。若存在负权边，Dijkstra 便不再安全；应改用 Bellman-Ford（$O(VE)$）。若图为 DAG，还能做得更好：按拓扑序松弛，达到 $O(V + E)$。
@@T0@@Non-negative edges only.@@T1@@\n.src: Non-negative edges only. The proof of correctness depends on every edge having non-negative weight. If you have negative edges, Dijkstra is unsafe; use Bellman-Ford ($O(VE)$). If your graph is a DAG, you can do better still: relax in topological order for $O(V + E)$.

Dijkstra has no notion of where the goal.zh: Dijkstra 对目标身处何方毫无概念。A* 修正了这一点：将优先级的键从「自起点起的代价」改为「@@T0@@经由此节点@@T1@@的估计总代价」：
Dijkstra has no notion of where the goal.src: Dijkstra has no notion of where the goal is. A* fixes that: change the priority key from "cost from start" to "estimated total cost through this node":

where $g(n)$ is the actual cost from sta.zh: 其中 $g(n)$ 为自起点到 $n$ 的实际代价，$h(n)$ 为从 $n$ 到目标的剩余代价的启发式估计。有三种情形：
where $g(n)$ is the actual cost from sta.src:
where $g(n)$ is the actual cost from start to $n$ and
          $h(n)$ is a heuristic estimate of the remaining cost from
          $n$ to goal. Three regimes:

@@T0@@$h \\equiv 0$.@@T1@@ A* reduces ex.zh: @@T0@@$h \equiv 0$。@@T1@@A* 恰好退化为 Dijkstra。慢，但最优。
@@T0@@$h \\equiv 0$.@@T1@@ A* reduces ex.src: $h \equiv 0$. A* reduces exactly to Dijkstra. Slow, optimal.

@@T0@@$h$ exactly equals the true remain.zh: @@T0@@$h$ 恰好等于真实的剩余代价。@@T1@@A* 只扩展最短路径上的节点。最优，且达到可能的最快速度。
@@T0@@$h$ exactly equals the true remain.src: $h$ exactly equals the true remaining cost. A* expands only the nodes on the shortest path. Optimal, fastest possible.

@@T0@@$h$ is anywhere between.@@T1@@ A*.zh: @@T0@@$h$ 介于两者之间。@@T1@@A* 大致扩展那些 $f$ 值不超过最优值的节点带。$h$ 越紧，带宽越窄。
@@T0@@$h$ is anywhere between.@@T1@@ A*.src: $h$ is anywhere between. A* expands roughly the band of nodes whose $f$-score is at most the optimum. Tighter $h$ means tighter band.

For correctness we need $h$ to be @@T0@@.zh: 为保证正确性，我们需要 $h$ 是@@T0@@可采纳@@T1@@的——它绝不能高估真实的剩余代价。在步长一致的四连通网格上，曼哈顿距离是可采纳的。在八连通（含对角）网格上，应使用切比雪夫距离或 octile 距离。欧氏距离在任何地方都可采纳，但在网格图上较为宽松。
For correctness we need $h$ to be @@T0@@.src: For correctness we need $h$ to be admissible — it must never overestimate the true remaining cost. On a 4-connected grid with uniform-cost steps, the Manhattan distance is admissible. On an 8-connected (diagonal) grid, use Chebyshev or octile distance. Euclidean distance is admissible everywhere but loose on grid graphs.

For A* to never re-expand a node we also.zh: 为使 A* 从不重新扩展节点，我们还要求 $h$ 是@@T0@@一致的@@T1@@（又称单调）：对每条边 $(n, n')$ 都有 $h(n) \le c(n, n') + h(n')$。网格上大多数「显然」的启发式——曼哈顿、欧氏——都是一致的。
For A* to never re-expand a node we also.src: For A* to never re-expand a node we also want $h$ to be consistent (a.k.a. monotone): $h(n) \le c(n, n') + h(n')$ for every edge $(n, n')$. Most "obvious" heuristics on grids — Manhattan, Euclidean — are consistent.

Greedy best-first — the cautionary tale.zh: 贪心最佳优先——前车之鉴

What if you priority-order on @@T0@@just.zh: 若@@T0@@仅@@T1@@按 $h(n)$ 排序优先级，而无视已付出的代价，会怎样？那就是@@T2@@贪心最佳优先搜索@@T3@@。它感觉像是丢掉了 $g$ 项的 A*，在简单地图上能极快地找到一条路径。但一旦贪心方向与目标之间横着一道墙，它便会一头扎进死胡同，再艰难地挣扎出来。
What if you priority-order on @@T0@@just.src: What if you priority-order on just $h(n)$, ignoring the cost paid so far? That's greedy best-first search. It feels like A* with the $g$-term dropped, and it can find a path very quickly on easy maps. But the moment a wall sits between the greedy direction and the goal, it dives into a dead end and slogs back out.

Greedy best-first is @@T0@@not@@T1@@ opt.zh: 贪心最佳优先@@T0@@并不@@T1@@最优。它会产生某条路径，可能远非最短。适用于以下情形：(a) 你信任该启发式；(b) 你更看重速度而非最优性；(c) 路径不佳时你可以重新规划。除此之外：请用 A*。
Greedy best-first is @@T0@@not@@T1@@ opt.src: Greedy best-first is not optimal. It produces some path, which may be far from shortest. Useful when (a) you trust the heuristic, (b) you want speed over optimality, and (c) you can re-plan if the path is bad. Otherwise: A*.

Try the C-shaped wall trap above with gr.zh: 用贪心最佳优先试试上方的 C 形墙陷阱；观察它如何撞上墙壁后才恢复。
Try the C-shaped wall trap above with gr.src:
Try the C-shaped wall trap above with greedy best-first;
          watch it bounce off the wall before recovering.

@@T0@@BFS is iterative deepening's frien.zh: @@T0@@BFS 是迭代加深的朋友，而非其替代。@@T1@@若你的图是无限的（或实际上无限），BFS 将在完成之前就把前沿的内存耗尽。迭代加深 DFS（IDDFS）保留了 DFS 的 $O(\text{depth})$ 内存，同时仍能找到最短路径。
@@T0@@BFS is iterative deepening's frien.src: BFS is iterative deepening's friend, not its replacement. If your graph is infinite (or effectively so), BFS will blow memory on the frontier before it finishes. Iterative deepening DFS (IDDFS) keeps DFS's $O(\text{depth})$ memory while still finding shortest paths.

@@T0@@A* re-expansion.@@T1@@ With a heur.zh: @@T0@@A* 的重新扩展。@@T1@@若启发式可采纳但@@T2@@不一致@@T3@@，某节点可能以更优的 $g$ 被重新加入前沿。处理方法是检查弹出节点的 $g$ 是否与记录的最优值相符；若不符则跳过。
@@T0@@A* re-expansion.@@T1@@ With a heur.src: A* re-expansion. With a heuristic that is admissible but not consistent, a node can be re-added to the frontier with a better $g$. Handle this by checking if the popped node's $g$ matches the recorded best; if not, skip.

@@T0@@Tie-breaking in A* matters.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@A* 中的平局打破很重要。@@T1@@两个 $f$ 相等的节点可能以不同顺序被弹出，而该顺序会改变 A* 返回的路径。标准技巧：打破平局时优先选择较大的 $g$（更接近目标）。这往往能大幅缩小已探索集合。
@@T0@@Tie-breaking in A* matters.@@T1@@.src: Tie-breaking in A* matters. Two nodes with equal $f$ can be popped in different orders, and the order changes which path A* returns. Standard trick: break ties by preferring the larger $g$ (closer to goal). This often shrinks the explored set dramatically.

@@T0@@Bidirectional search.@@T1@@ Run BF.zh: @@T0@@双向搜索。@@T1@@同时从起点@@T2@@与@@T3@@目标运行 BFS / A*；当前沿相遇时停止。最好情况下将工作量开平方（分支因子为 $b$、深度为 $d$ 时，由 $O(b^d)$ 变为 $O(b^{d/2})$）。
@@T0@@Bidirectional search.@@T1@@ Run BF.src: Bidirectional search. Run BFS / A* from start and goal simultaneously; stop when the frontiers meet. Squares the work in the best case ($O(b^{d/2})$ instead of $O(b^d)$ for branching factor $b$ and depth $d$).

@@T0@@Jump-point search.@@T1@@ On unifor.zh: @@T0@@跳点搜索。@@T1@@在单位代价网格上，当没有值得关注的变化时，可以整段跳过单元格。在游戏地图上比 A* 提速一个数量级。
@@T0@@Jump-point search.@@T1@@ On unifor.src: Jump-point search. On uniform-cost grids, you can skip whole runs of cells when nothing interesting changes. Order-of-magnitude speed-up over A* for game maps.

@@T0@@D* and LPA*.@@T1@@ When the graph.zh: @@T0@@D* 与 LPA*。@@T1@@当图发生变化（障碍出现、边被关闭）时，从零重新规划颇为浪费。D* Lite 复用上一次运行的信息；它是火星车路径规划器背后的经典算法。
@@T0@@D* and LPA*.@@T1@@ When the graph.src: D* and LPA*. When the graph is changing (obstacles appear, edges close), replanning from scratch is wasteful. D* Lite reuses information from the previous run; the canonical algorithm behind Mars-rover path planners.

@@T0@@Dijkstra, 1959@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@.zh: @@T0@@Dijkstra，1959@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A note on two problems in connexion with graphs.@@T3@@两页篇幅。六十余年来始终是首选算法。
@@T0@@Dijkstra, 1959@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@.src: Dijkstra, 1959 — A note on two problems in connexion with graphs. Two pages. Stays the algorithm of choice for sixty-plus years.

@@T0@@Hart, Nilsson, Raphael, 1968@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@Hart、Nilsson、Raphael，1968@@T1@@ — @@T2@@A Formal Basis for the Heuristic Determination of Minimum Cost Paths.@@T3@@A* 的原始论文。
@@T0@@Hart, Nilsson, Raphael, 1968@@T1@@.src: Hart, Nilsson, Raphael, 1968 — A Formal Basis for the Heuristic Determination of Minimum Cost Paths. The original A* paper.

@@T0@@Pearl, 1984@@T1@@ &mdash; @@T2@@He.zh: @@T0@@Pearl，1984@@T1@@ — @@T2@@Heuristics: Intelligent Search Strategies for Computer Problem Solving.@@T3@@关于可采纳性、一致性以及 A* 家族的权威论述。

meta.title: 图搜索：逐层推进前沿
meta.tagline: BFS、DFS、Dijkstra、A*——四种搜索策略在同一网格迷宫中竞速
meta.summary: BFS 能在无权图上找到最短路径，却盲目探索。Dijkstra 能处理权重，却无视目标。A* 引入启发式函数，如箭一般径直抵达——前提是该启发式可采纳。在网格上绘制墙壁与权重区域，观察四种经典搜索算法如何扩展各自的前沿，并看清每一种究竟在何处浪费了工作。
highlights: 点击网格绘制墙壁；拖拽起点或目标；选择 BFS / DFS / Dijkstra / A* 并观察前沿如何扩展。
并排对比：同一迷宫、四种搜索，看清每种算法不必要地探索了哪些单元格。
加入高代价地形（泥地），观察 Dijkstra 如何绕行，而 BFS 径直穿过。
切换 A* 的启发式函数（曼哈顿、欧氏、零），观察从 Dijkstra 到贪心最佳优先的连续谱。
实时报告路径长度、扩展的单元格数与最优性。
